links.outcome: LLM performance on differential diagnosis and other dimensions in simulated patient-clinician conversations
links.effect: All 9 LLMs showed low performance across a variety of dimensions, particularly differential diagnosis, across 7,097 simulated conversations scored on 105 dimensions (1-4 scale).
links.quote: For all LLMs, we observe low performance across a variety of dimensions, in particular on differential diagnosis.

unlisted_practices: Multi-dimensional simulated-patient conversation benchmark using synthetic patient packets and committee-based LLM judges aligned to ACGME competencies

screen.reason: The study develops and applies a multi-dimensional benchmark (MedPI) to evaluate large language models in multi-turn patient-clinician conversations across safety and clinical dimensions, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
